# color-spaces.library: ToColorHSV

**Status:** Supported (tier `graphics`). In a shipping tier; the lint, type-check, and code-generation gates cover it. No release promises its signature yet.

## Summary

> The hexcone reading of a linear colour: value is the largest channel,
> saturation the spread over it, hue the sector the largest channel picks.
> Grey (zero spread) reads as hue zero, black additionally as saturation
> zero; alpha does not participate.

```plato

    // The hexcone reading of a linear colour: value is the largest channel,
    // saturation the spread over it, hue the sector the largest channel picks.
    // Grey (zero spread) reads as hue zero, black additionally as saturation
    // zero; alpha does not participate.
    ToColorHSV(self: Color): ColorHSV
    {
        var value = self.R.Max(self.G).Max(self.B);
        var spread = value - self.R.Min(self.G).Min(self.B);
        var sector =
            spread == 0.0 ? 0.0
            : value == self.R ? ((self.G - self.B) / spread).Modulo(6.0)
            : value == self.G ? (self.B - self.R) / spread + 2.0
            : (self.R - self.G) / spread + 4.0;
        return ColorHSV(
            (sector / 6.0).Turns,
            value == 0.0 ? 0.0 : spread / value,
            value);
    }
```
